entries.context: Formal solicitation where the buyer evaluates technical approach and commercial terms, not price alone; RFP
entries.definition_zh: 采购方邀请供应商提交技术方案、商务条件和价格建议的正式采购文件，通常采用综合评审。

entries.context: Owner-issued invitation to selected or registered suppliers to collect documents and submit a tender; ITT
entries.definition_zh: 业主向特定或已注册供应商发出的参加招标并提交投标文件的正式邀请。

entries.context: Formal invitation used in competitive bidding; IFB
entries.definition_zh: 采购方向市场或受邀供应商正式发出的竞争性投标邀请，通常用于规格和评审规则较明确的采购。

entries.context: Early-stage supplier response used to identify interested and potentially qualified firms; EOI
entries.definition_zh: 供应商在正式招标前表达参与意愿并提供初步资质信息的文件，不等同于正式投标。

entries.context: Complete owner-issued package governing tender preparation and submission
entries.definition_zh: 业主发布的完整招标资料包，通常包括投标人须知、技术规范、数据表、合同条件、报价表和提交要求。

entries.context: Mandatory procedural instructions for preparing, signing, securing and submitting a tender
entries.definition_zh: 规定投标文件组成、签署、密封、截止时间、担保、澄清和提交程序的强制性说明。

entries.context: Project-specific data that supplements the general instructions to bidders; BDS
entries.definition_zh: 对通用投标人须知进行项目化补充的数据表，载明日期、地址、币种、担保、有效期和评审等具体要求。

entries.context: Technical portion of a tender covering compliance, design, materials, testing, drawings and delivery capability
entries.definition_zh: 投标文件中说明产品技术符合性、设计、材料、检验、文件和供货能力的部分，通常不应包含价格。

entries.context: Commercial portion containing prices and contractual terms; owner usage may call it financial proposal
entries.definition_zh: 投标文件中包含价格、付款、交货、贸易术语、有效期和商务条件的部分；部分业主称为财务建议书。

entries.context: World Bank and project-procurement term for the non-price technical part submitted in a separate envelope
entries.definition_zh: 在双信封或综合评审采购中单独提交的技术方案文件，强调方法、符合性和实施能力。

entries.context: Price and financial part of a two-envelope submission
entries.definition_zh: 双信封投标中载明价格、费用和财务条件的独立部分，在技术评审完成后按规则开启。

entries.context: Commercial terms and schedules submitted without any price figures for early review
entries.definition_zh: 用于先行审查商务条件和偏差、但不显示任何价格数字的商务投标文件。

entries.context: Commercial bid containing unit prices, totals and financial conditions
entries.definition_zh: 包含单价、总价和财务条件的商务标，需按招标文件要求与技术标隔离提交。

entries.context: Technical and financial proposals are sealed separately and opened in sequence
entries.definition_zh: 技术文件和财务文件分别密封并按规定顺序开启、评审的投标程序。

entries.context: Formal owner-issued amendment or supplement that becomes part of the tender documents
entries.definition_zh: 招标方在投标截止前正式发布、对原招标文件进行补充或修改并构成其组成部分的文件。

entries.context: Owner-hosted meeting before bid submission to explain requirements and receive questions
entries.definition_zh: 投标截止前由招标方组织、用于说明要求并集中接收投标人问题的会议。

entries.context: Post-submission question or response used to clarify a bid without unauthorized material change
entries.definition_zh: 投标提交后，招标方或投标人为解释文件内容而提出和回复的问题，不应借此实质性改变投标。

entries.context: Clause-by-clause table mapping tender requirements to bidder response and supporting documents
entries.definition_zh: 按招标条款逐项列明是否符合、响应位置、证明文件和偏差情况的对照表。

entries.context: Consolidated schedule of all technical and commercial exceptions to tender requirements
entries.definition_zh: 集中列明投标文件相对招标要求的全部技术和商务偏差、例外及投标人建议条件的表格。

entries.context: Bidder declaration that the offer contains no exceptions to tender requirements
entries.definition_zh: 投标人正式确认其投标对招标技术和商务要求不存在未披露偏差或保留的声明。

entries.context: Contractual description of required engineering, supply, inspection, documentation and services; SOW
entries.definition_zh: 界定承包商或供应商需完成的设计、供货、检验、文件和服务责任边界的合同文件。

entries.context: Mandatory product, material, design, testing and documentation requirements
entries.definition_zh: 规定阀门产品、材料、设计、制造、检验和文件要求的强制性技术文件。

entries.context: Owner-prescribed form for item prices, quantities, currencies, totals and related charges
entries.definition_zh: 按招标方格式填写物料、数量、单价、币种、总价及相关费用的投标表格。

entries.context: Measured quantities used for tender pricing and contract valuation; BOQ
entries.definition_zh: 列明各项工作或供货项目及其计量数量、供投标人填写价格并用于合同计价的清单。

entries.context: Final date and time by which a complete bid must be received

zh: 递交投标文件截止时间

entries.definition_zh: 招标方必须收到完整投标文件的最终日期和时间，逾期提交通常会被拒绝。

entries.context: Period during which the bidder's offer and commitments remain binding
entries.definition_zh: 投标人承诺其投标价格和条件保持有效并可被招标方接受的期限，不等同于普通报价有效期。

entries.context: Bank or demand guarantee securing repayment of the advance if the supplier fails to perform
entries.definition_zh: 买方支付预付款后，由银行或担保人出具、在供应商不履约时保障预付款返还的担保。

entries.context: Guarantee replacing cash retention or securing obligations during the defects/warranty period
entries.definition_zh: 用于替代合同保留款或保障缺陷责任期义务的保函；是否等同质保保函须按业主文本判断。

entries.context: Security for repair, replacement or defect-remedy obligations after delivery or completion

ar: خطاب ضمان الالتزامات خلال فترة الضمان

entries.definition_zh: 保障供应商在质保期内履行维修、更换和缺陷整改责任的担保，部分业主与保留款保函合并使用。

entries.context: Corporate undertaking by the bidder's parent to support subsidiary performance
entries.definition_zh: 由投标人或供应商的母公司出具、承诺支持子公司履行合同义务的公司担保，不等同银行保函。

entries.context: Independent bank undertaking securing tender or contract obligations
entries.definition_zh: 由银行出具、按规定条件向受益人付款的独立担保，可用于投标、履约、预付款或质保等目的。

entries.context: Bank payment undertaking against compliant documents; LC
entries.definition_zh: 银行依据申请人指示，在受益人提交相符单据时履行付款责任的结算工具，不应与违约触发的银行保函混用。

entries.context: Generic procurement-law term for security ensuring contract performance; may be a bond, guarantee or other permitted instrument
entries.definition_zh: 确保中标人履行合同义务的通用担保概念，形式可能为银行保函、保证金或其他招标文件允许的工具。

entries.context: Creating and approving a supplier record in the owner's procurement system
entries.definition_zh: 在业主采购系统中建立并审核供应商主体资料、联系人和必要证照的准入步骤，不代表已获得产品资格。

entries.context: Owner assessment of supplier capability for defined product or service groups before tender eligibility
entries.definition_zh: 业主在邀请投标前，针对特定产品或服务类别评估供应商技术、质量、财务和履约能力的过程。

entries.context: Structured questionnaire collecting legal, financial, technical, quality and manufacturing evidence; PQQ
entries.definition_zh: 用于收集供应商法律、财务、技术、质量、制造和业绩资料的结构化预审表。

entries.context: Unique ERP identifier issued after supplier registration and required for QatarEnergy procurement documents
entries.definition_zh: 供应商注册获批后由业主ERP系统分配的唯一编号，常是接收RFQ、ITT和订单文件的必要条件。

entries.context: Owner or project list of suppliers approved for specific commodities; AVL
entries.definition_zh: 业主或项目针对特定物料类别批准可参与供货的供应商名单，注册供应商不一定已进入该名单。

entries.context: Plant-specific qualification of a manufacturer, including technical review, quality review and factory audit
entries.definition_zh: 针对实际生产工厂开展的技术、质量、财务和现场审核，区别于贸易商或一般供应商注册。

entries.context: ADNOC onboarding review covering ownership, sanctions, ethics and integrity risks; IDD
entries.definition_zh: 供应商准入中对所有权、制裁、反腐败、道德和商业诚信风险进行的专项尽职调查。

entries.context: Mandatory ethical, legal, labor, environmental and compliance expectations for suppliers
entries.definition_zh: 业主要求供应商遵守的道德、反腐败、劳动、环境、安全和合规行为规范。

entries.context: ADNOC/Gulf metric for value retained in the host economy through local spend, employment and investment; ICV
entries.definition_zh: 衡量采购在项目所在国形成的本地采购、就业、投资和经济增值的指标；ADNOC称ICV，Aramco对应体系为iktva。

entries.context: Government-issued evidence that the company is legally registered to conduct business; CR
entries.definition_zh: 政府签发、证明公司合法登记并获准从事相应经营活动的证书，是海湾业主供应商注册和投标常见必交件。

entries.context: Company letter identifying persons authorized to sign bids, contracts or portal transactions
entries.definition_zh: 公司正式确认哪些人员有权代表其签署投标、合同或采购平台交易文件的授权函。

entries.context: Organization that will operate or consume the supplied valves, which may differ from buyer or EPC contractor
entries.definition_zh: 最终安装、运行或使用阀门的组织，可能不同于询价方、采购方或EPC承包商。

entries.context: Entity owning the project and setting ultimate technical and commercial requirements
entries.definition_zh: 拥有项目并最终确定技术、商务和批准要求的主体；合同中也可能称Employer或Company，须按文件定义使用。

entries.context: Contractor responsible for engineering, procurement and construction and often issuing valve RFQs

zh: 设计采购施工总承包商
ru: подрядчик по проектированию, закупкам и строительству

entries.definition_zh: 承担项目设计、采购和施工整体责任的总承包商，常代业主向阀门制造商发出询价和技术澄清。

entries.context: Formal letter informing the successful bidder that the contract has been awarded; LOA
entries.definition_zh: 招标方正式通知中标人合同已授予的函件，是否立即形成合同义务取决于招标文件和函件措辞。

entries.context: Official notification of the procurement award to the successful bidder and sometimes other bidders
entries.definition_zh: 正式告知采购授标结果的通知，可发给中标人并按规则通知其他投标人。

entries.context: Agreement establishing terms for future call-off contracts without necessarily guaranteeing quantity
entries.definition_zh: 在一定期限内预先约定价格机制、范围和条件，以便后续下达订单或分合同的协议，通常不保证最低采购量。

entries.context: Standard contractual provisions applying across projects; GCC
entries.definition_zh: 适用于该业主或采购体系多数合同的标准条款，通常由专用条款对项目细节进行补充或修改。

entries.context: Project-specific provisions supplementing or amending the general conditions; SCC
entries.definition_zh: 针对具体项目补充、细化或修改合同通用条款的项目专用规定。

entries.context: ICC rules allocating delivery, carriage, customs, costs and risk between seller and buyer
entries.definition_zh: ICC发布的国际贸易术语规则，用于明确交货点、运输、保险、清关、费用和风险转移；必须与具体术语及地点一起写明。

entries.context: Specific destination stated after a C or D Incoterms rule
entries.definition_zh: 在C组或D组Incoterms术语后明确写出的目的地点；其是否为风险转移点取决于所用术语。

entries.context: Port where goods are loaded or delivered for shipment under maritime terms
entries.definition_zh: 货物装船或交付承运人的起运港；在FOB、CFR、CIF等海运术语中必须准确指定。

entries.context: Submission of a document package for owner/EPC review, comment or approval
entries.definition_zh: 供应商按项目程序提交给业主或EPC进行审查、评论或批准的一次文件报审动作或资料包。

entries.context: Controlled cover record identifying documents, revisions, purpose and recipients in a transmission
entries.definition_zh: 记录本次发送文件的编号、版本、用途、收件方和日期的受控封面单，不等同文件本身。

entries.context: Controlled list of all supplier documents, numbers, revisions, planned dates and review status; SDR
entries.definition_zh: 统一登记供应商全部文件编号、名称、版本、计划日期和审查状态的受控清单。

entries.context: Final compiled vendor dossier containing approved drawings, certificates, reports and manuals; VDB
entries.definition_zh: 供货结束时汇编的最终资料包，通常包括批准图纸、材质证书、检验报告、合格证和操作维护手册；与MRB边界按业主定义。

entries.context: Planned dates for initial, revised and final issue of each supplier document
entries.definition_zh: 列明供应商各类文件首次提交、修改版和最终版计划日期的进度表。

human_review_required.issue: Some owners use Commercial Bid for all non-technical terms, while World Bank documents use Financial Proposal for the price envelope.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Keep both keys and choose the target term from the owner's tender definitions.

human_review_required.issue: Gulf Arabic alternates among جدول الانحرافات, جدول الاستثناءات and جدول التحفظات; each can carry a slightly different legal tone.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Use the exact owner template heading when available; default to جدول الانحرافات.

human_review_required.issue: Some projects treat retention guarantee and warranty/maintenance bond as interchangeable; others issue them at different contract milestones.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Do not merge with Warranty Bond until the contract security clause is read.

human_review_required.issue: Warranty Bond, Maintenance Bond and retention-release security are not interchangeable in every Gulf owner contract.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Confirm the covered obligations and effective period from the contract security clause before selecting the Arabic heading.

human_review_required.issue: This is a generic procurement-law concept, while Performance Bond is a specific instrument already present in the production/research vocabulary.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Retain both only if the runtime can distinguish generic security from a bank bond.

human_review_required.issue: ADNOC uses ICV, Saudi Aramco uses iktva, and other Gulf owners use local-content formulas with different certificates.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Never replace the owner's program name with another operator's acronym.

human_review_required.issue: Owner, Employer, Company, Buyer and End User may be different legal entities in EPC tenders.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Use the capitalized party name defined in the contract rather than assuming these roles are synonymous.

human_review_required.issue: In owner document-control systems, a submittal normally means a controlled package sent for review or approval, not any document delivery.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Use the owner's workflow label and distinguish review submittals from final handover dossiers.

human_review_required.issue: Owner document-control procedures may use VDB, MRB and final dossier for overlapping or different deliverables.
human_review_required.decision_needed: Map to the owner's document index before merging with Manufacturing Record Book.

self_check_summary.notes: Comparison is case-insensitive and trims surrounding whitespace. Existing concepts such as RFQ, Bid Bond, Performance Bond, Quotation Validity, Delivery Schedule, Inspection and Test Plan and For Your Reference were intentionally not duplicated.
